description: Transvaalbuurt 1931 portiek rows of Afrikanerplein 33-51: 6.7-6.8 m dark brown brick stair-block pands of five storeys, a low 2.85 m ground storey laid in brick with thin light courses every 0.3 m under a cream sill band, three 2.95 m storeys and a 2.85 m top storey, three axes of white two-light casements with a top light at a 2.2 m pitch (the top storey's windows narrow, 0.7 m), cream concrete sills; the portiek door on the axis against one party wall, a shallow box bay (erker) over it on storeys 1-2 that meets its mirrored neighbour's; a flat roof run out as a thin light eaves slab at 14.1-14.55 m

match.note: Afrikanerplein 33-51 (BAG 1931, 10 pands of 6.7-6.8 m; 3DBAG eaves 14.9-15.0 m, bouwlagen 4-5) on the 2020-04-29 strip, gridded 1 m: the eaves slab foot 14.1 m, top 14.55 m (frontEavesM; 3DBAG reads 0.35 m higher). 25-27 and 29-31 carry the same grid but are BAG 1989 (a rebuild behind the old front, or an infill in its image): the year vetoes them and they stay with the city tier; 53 (8.5 m) and 55 (9.4 m) are the corner design (a taller ground storey with a cream band at 4.0 m, a ledge at 10.2 m) and stay outside the width range. Axis pitch 1.6-3.0 m: three columns over 6.7 m (2.2 m). Wall: match.measuredWall false, one brick for the row (lesson 10): #53443d, fitted through the city tint (fit-wall-palette fitWallBrick) so the drawn wall #715b4f of #634f45 meets #63524a, the per-channel median of the review's photo walls of the tree-free 35, 41, 45 and 49 (#604f47, #65554c, #66554d, #625148); the per-pand refit read street-tree green on 43 and 47

flat-slab.note: Afrikanerplein 35 (125852): a thin light grey eaves slab 14.1-14.55 m over the top-storey windows (raw #928b82), V-shaped rainwater heads at the party walls; flat roof

door-right.note: the blue portiek door (1.0 m, 0-2.3 m) on the axis against the right party wall, beside its mirrored neighbour's: two doors and two erkers meet at every other party wall; ground windows 0.56-2.29 m on the other axes

roof.evidence: Afrikanerplein 33-51 strip 2020-04-29: sky directly over the eaves slab along the row, no roof face; 3DBAG roof max 14.9-15.0 m = eaves

rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: door + 2 windows | 1-3: 3 windows (the erker on the door axis on 1-2) | 4: 3 narrow windows
rhythm.symmetry: a pair of pands mirrors about the party wall with the doors and erkers
rhythm.groundFloor: portiek door at one party wall, two windows; banded brick
rhythm.roofline: flat; a thin light eaves slab

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2020-04-29 at 40 px/m, gridded 1 m (staging/block-face/transvaalbuurt/5b/afrikanerplein-25-55-28-50-grid.png): 35 (125852) windows 35.8-37.0, 38.0-39.2, 40.25-41.4 m; rows 0.56-2.29 (ground), 3.6-5.46, 6.46-8.38, 9.4-11.3, 12.5-13.96 m (top windows 0.67 m wide); cream sill band 2.55-2.75 m over banded brick; eaves slab 14.1-14.55 m; the blue-framed box erkers of 33 (right axis) and 35 (left axis) on storeys 1-2 meet at their party wall over the doors
raw strip wall #634f45/#625047/#635046 on the piers of 35 and 37 (6.5-9.3 m), #675c52 on 47-49; cream sills/band #655747 raw (#c9c0a8 trim); eaves slab #928b82 raw

schemaLimits: the erkers are shallow canted boxes with blue frames; drawn as square box frames (bayWindows.hood) in the trim colour
the rainwater heads and downpipes at the party walls are not drawn
the ground storey's light courses are drawn as thin band-brick stripes (brickStripes)
notes: Palette: the type default is the raw strip wall of tree-free piers; every placed pand takes its trim-normalised strip wall (auto-place measuredPalette); one brick per row at review (lesson 10).
